data.title: 常陆茉子 · 盖错格的归还章
data.description: 茉子把借书卡往灯下转了半圈，才发现日期章落在上一行。她从桌边拉过便签，认真补写上今天的日期，再把书递还给等在柜台外的同学。
data.action: 在借书卡旁用笔补写日期，另一只手扶住书
data.lighting: 近处台灯照亮纸面，窗边还有日光
data.camera: 斜侧中景，手和图书入镜
data.promptProse: Mako holds a library book open flat against the counter and writes the correct return date on a small slip beside its card. Her green ribbon and navy sailor collar are just above the warm circle on the desktop. The edge of a date stamp is visible beside the book.
data.animaCaption: She steadies the book with one hand while copying the date onto a spare note.
